improvements: Replaced the fully glazed upper elevation with a ribbed opaque metal skin and glazed ground floor from an independent facade reference.
Removed the fabricated giant white name panel and retained the exact mapped outline.
Added the enclosed glazed footbridge from the Unirea car park to the Carrefour building on its mapped line (w231671712, 13 m), with the Carrefour name on both sides.
The registry entry now requests ground-floor tenant signs from OSM (unitSigns). Those signs are placed by the district world and are not part of the isolated model shown here.

Facade from Street View from Piata Unirii (May 2024): large flat white-grey panels on the south front and the south-west rotunda with a blank white billboard frame on the curve; the west front on Bd. I. C. Bratianu is a dark bronze louvred wall with one full-height banner; a white canopy band over the recessed glazed ground floor. It replaces the uniform grey ribbed skin.
remainingGaps: Roof height 28.5 m remains estimated from the six-level source; the facade reference is dated 2017 and current tenant branding was not inferred.
Neighbour overlap, terrain support and tourist-scene context need the separate district/scene pass; isolated model pictures do not establish complete parity.

Footbridge deck height (6 m), section (3.2 × 3 m) and lettering size are estimates; OSM gives no dimensions. In the isolated study the bridge ends in mid-air because the Carrefour building belongs to the district data, not to this model.
Ground-floor tenant signs are not visible in these studies; they need an in-world capture in Unirii, which was not made for this record.
Panel module, louvre pitch and banner size are estimates; the banner is a plain red canvas, its advertising is not reproduced. Street View viewed as reference only; not stored or published.
